title: Japan visa
tagline: Short-term visa for tourism, family visits and business trips.
intro:
The Embassy of Japan looks closely at your travel plan: where you will be each day, who pays for the trip and how you are tied to Kyrgyzstan.

We build a clear day-by-day itinerary, help with documents from an inviting party (if any) and review your financial documents.
services: Advice on the inviting party’s documents

sections.heading: Tourist and visitor visas
sections.body: For tourism, the application rests on the itinerary and bookings. For family or business visits you need documents from the inviting party in Japan: an invitation letter, a letter of guarantee and a schedule of stay. We tell you which forms to request and how to fill them in correctly.

documents: Invitation and letter of guarantee — for visitor/business visas

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We define the purpose and the required documents.

steps.title: Itinerary and bookings
steps.text: We build the daily plan and make reservations.

steps.title: Form and review
steps.text: We complete the form and check the package.

steps.title: Submission
steps.text: You submit at the embassy; we stay in touch until the decision.

faq.q: How long does a Japan visa take?
faq.a: Usually about a week after submission, but some cases take longer. Apply at least a month before travel.

faq.q: Do I need an invitation for tourism?
faq.a: No — for a tourist trip the itinerary, bookings and financial documents are enough.
Study requires a student visa issued on the basis of a Certificate of Eligibility (CoE) from the school. Message us and we will suggest options.

seo_description: Japan visa from Bishkek: tourist, visitor and business. Itinerary, bookings, application form and document review.
